blocks.html:
This method retrieves a tax region. It sends a request to the
[Get Tax Region](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#tax-regions\_gettaxregionsid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the tax region to retrieve.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the tax region.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: province_code
children.description: The tax region's lower-case [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO\_3166-2) province or state code.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the tax region.

children.name: parent_id
children.description: The ID of the parent tax region.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the tax provider for the region.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the tax region was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the tax region was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the tax region was deleted.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user who created the tax region.

children.name: tax_rates
children.description: The tax rates associated with the tax region.
